questions.prompt: A bookshop displays a novel marked 12 pounds. A customer takes it to the till and offers 12 pounds. Using IRAC, advise whether the shop must sell.

mark_scheme.descriptor: issue: is the display an offer
rule: a display is generally an invitation to treat
applies it: the customer's offer at the till can be accepted or refused

questions.prompt: Explain why a promise to give a gift is generally not enforceable.

mark_scheme.descriptor: a gift gives nothing in exchange
so there is nothing to enforce

questions.prompt: Leo says 'I will sell you my bike for 150.' Mia replies 'Would you take 120?' Leo says no. Mia then says 'Then I accept 150.' Using IRAC, advise whether a contract exists.

mark_scheme.descriptor: rule: a counter-offer ends the original offer

applies it: 'Would you take 120?' may only be a request for information, but Leo's refusal confirms the 150 offer stayed open, so Mia's later acceptance can still be valid, unless the question was a counter-offer
the better view depends on whether the question was a counter-offer or an enquiry
